codeReview.summary: The commit does create the requested directory skeleton and a thin entrypoint, but it does not satisfy the modular-structure contract or preserve the old gateway behavior. Routing still depends on a 1,364-line `voice-routing.ts`, the new handler modules are not wired into the live request path, the response payload drops fields that existed before the refactor, and STT validation paths return plain objects cast as `Response` instead of real HTTP responses.

issues.description: `processStt()` returns plain objects like `{ status: 400, body: ... } as unknown as Response` on its validation/error paths (for example lines 110-113, 122-125, 131-134, 160-163, and 174-177). `handleRequest()` returns `sttResult.response` directly, so invalid audio or empty-input requests will not produce a real `Response` instance at runtime. These branches need `jsonResponse(...)` or `new Response(...)` instead of a type cast.

The refactored response body no longer includes `stt_latency_ms`, `tts_generation_ms`, or `tts_skipped_reason`. Those fields were present in the pre-refactor contract (`supabase/functions/ai-gateway/index.ts` in the parent commit at lines 2763-2765), and the feature description explicitly required preserving the existing response format so the client keeps working during the transition.

The gateway is still anchored to a 1,364-line routing monolith, so VAL-BE-030's 'no single file exceeds 500 lines' assertion is not met. `handlers/main.ts` still imports core route/voice-log behavior from `../voice-routing.ts` (lines 6-24) and keeps route handling inline (lines 154-310), while `handleAdvisory`, `handleFarmQuery`, `handleVoiceLog`, and `handleClarify` are only defined/re-exported and never referenced anywhere else in the committed tree.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The backend-worker skill and mission conventions both say to write failing tests first, but this refactor handoff reports `followedProcedure: true` while adding no tests at all. Shared guidance should either require focused regression coverage for refactors like this or explicitly document when existing-suite-only validation is acceptable.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission has a canonical Jest command in `.factory/services.yaml`, but the worker ran `npm test 2>&1 | tail -30` and later `npm test 2>&1 | tail -10` from the transcript skeleton. That pattern hides Jest's real exit status unless `pipefail` is set, so shared guidance should steer workers to the services.yaml command and explicitly forbid piping validators through `tail`/`head`.

summary: Fail. The refactor created the requested folders and a thin `index.ts`, but it still leaves a 1,364-line `voice-routing.ts`, drops previously shipped response fields, and returns fake `Response` objects on STT validation failures, so the modular-structure and backward-compatibility requirements are not met.
